source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Note 11 Income Taxes, cash income taxes paid
source.quote: Income taxes, net of amounts refunded $ 2,220,384 [USD thousands; year ended December 31, 2025]

notes: Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet, net of refunds, from the FY2025 income-tax note's table by jurisdiction (federal 1,120,172; state and local 273,976; Brazil 275,106; Korea 195,302; all other foreign 355,828 thousand); the 10-K no longer prints a cash-taxes line in the cash-flow supplement. R&D not reported as a separate line. Netflix reports 'Technology and development' ($3,391,390 thousand in 2025), but the 10-K describes it as payroll and related costs for technology personnel improving the service and does not call it research and development, so it is not recorded.
